You know, for those cases where you need interactive elements to play around with but your UI is mostly text.

### Extra information {style="margin-bottom: 30px;"}


::: column-page

```{r}
tib_tags <- tibble::tibble(
  headings = c(
    'Cool stuff 🚀',
    'More cool stuff 💰',
    'Another cool thing ⚙️',
    'Extra super cool thing 💡',
    'A fifth cool thing, yay 🧲'
  ),
  text = 'Duis imperdiet, est vitae mollis porttitor, neque metus ornare urna, a ullamcorper dolor sem at tellus.' 
) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    headings = purrr::map(
      headings, 
      \(x) htmltools::div(htmltools::strong(x))
    ),
    text = purrr::map(
      text, 
      htmltools::div
    ),
    combined = purrr::map2(
      headings,
      text,
      \(x, y) htmltools::div(
        style = htmltools::css(
          width = '300px',
          margin_right = '20px',
          margin_bottom = '20px'
        ),
        x, 
        y
      )
    )
  )

htmltools::div(
  style = htmltools::css(
    display = 'flex',
    flex_wrap = 'wrap'
  ),
  tib_tags$combined
)
```

:::

### Interactive part

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
library(bslib)
library(ggplot2)
source("code.R")
```


```{r}
#| column: page
layout_sidebar(
  height = 600,
  sidebar =  sidebar(
    shiny::selectizeInput(
      'select_area', 
      'Visible Areas', 
      choices = unique(df_sf$Area_name),
      selected = c("River Fynn and River Lark", "Tidal River Deben", "Non-Tidal River Deben"),
      multiple = TRUE
    )
  ),
  shiny::plotOutput('output_plot')
)
```

```{r}
#| context: server

output$output_plot <- shiny::renderPlot({

df_sf |>
  dplyr::filter(
      Area_name %in% input$select_area
    ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(x = date_actual, y = E_coli_count_Colonies_per_1ml)
  ) +
  geom_smooth(aes(color = Area_name),
    se = FALSE, alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 2) +
  labs(y = "E.coli Colonies per 1ml", x = "Date") +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey98"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    # aes(color = E_coli_count_Colonies_per_1ml),
    aes(color = Area_name),
    size = 4,
    width = 10
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scico::scale_color_scico_d()
})
```

### Interactive 3

```{r}
#| column: page

library(leaflet)

layout_sidebar(
  height = 600,
  sidebar =  sidebar(
    shiny::selectizeInput(
      'select_area', 
      'Visible Areas', 
      choices = unique(df_sf$Area_name),
      selected = c("River Fynn and River Lark", "Tidal River Deben", "Non-Tidal River Deben"),
      multiple = TRUE
    )
  ),
  leafletOutput("map", width = "100%", height = "100%")
)
```

```{r}
#| context: server
# Create the map

df_sf$longitude <- sf::st_coordinates(df_sf)[,1]
df_sf$latitude <- sf::st_coordinates(df_sf)[,2]

library(leaflet)
output$map <- renderLeaflet({
  leaflet() %>%
    addTiles() %>%
    setView(lng = 1.337325608, lat = 52.08806268, zoom = 11)
})
leafletProxy("map", data = df_sf) |> 
      clearShapes() |> 
      addCircles(~longitude, ~latitude, 
      radius = ~E_coli_count_Colonies_per_1ml, 
      # radius=radius,
      # layerId=~zipcode,
      stroke=FALSE, 
      fillOpacity = 0.4,
      fillColor = ~E_coli_count_Colonies_per_1ml
      )

```
